'''PTC India Limited''', formerly '''Power Trading Corporation of India Limited''', is an Indian company that provides power trading solutions, cross border power trading, and consultancy services. Headquartered in [[New Delhi]], the company also has operations in [[Nepal]], [[Bhutan]], and [[Bangladesh]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Company Overview of PTC India Limited |url=https://www.bloomberg.com/research/stocks/private/snapshot.asp?privcapId=9132241 |website=Bloomberg |accessdate=24 March 2019}}</ref> PTC India's subsidiaries PTC India Financial Services Limited and PTC Energy Limited provide financial assistance for companies in the power sector and run renewable energy projects respectively.<ref name = "BusinessStandard1">{{cite web |title=PTC India Ltd. (PTC) - Company History |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/ptc-india-20076/information/company-history |website=Business Standard India |accessdate=24 March 2019}}</ref> 16% of the company is publicly owned by the Indian government.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-01-11 |first=Rishi Ranjan |last=Kala |title=Adani, Reliance Power eye govt stake in PTC India |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/adani-reliance-power-eye-govt-stake-in-ptc-india/article66365830.ece |access-date=2023-07-04 |website=www.thehindubusinessline.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |first= Varun |last=Vyas |date=2023-02-20 |title=Adani decides against bid for stake in state-backed PTC India - Bloomberg News |language=en |work=Reuters |url=https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/adani-decides-against-bid-stake-state-backed-ptc-india-bloomberg-news-2023-02-20/ |access-date=2023-07-04}}</ref>


As of January 2019, PTC Energy managed a renewable energy portfolio of around 290 megawatts of wind assets across Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Dhanjal |first1=Swaraj Singh |title=PTC India begins process to find investor for wind energy business |url=https://www.livemint.com/Industry/b2k3VFJTAfBZFfKbJCvGdO/PTC-India-begins-process-to-find-investor-for-wind-energy-bu.html |website=Mint |accessdate=24 March 2019 |language=en |date=6 January 2019}}</ref>

In 2020, PTC received approval to create India's third [[electricity market|power exchange]] after [[Indian Energy Exchange]] (IEX) and Power Exchange India (PXIL).<ref>{{Cite web |last=Jai |first=Shreya |date=2020-08-04 |title=PTC India gets nod to set up third power exchange; launch likely by next FY |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/ptc-india-gets-nod-to-set-up-third-power-exchange-launch-likely-by-next-fy-120080400042_1.html |access-date=2023-07-04 |website=www.business-standard.com |language=en-US}}</ref>

PTC India Limited, formerly Power Trading Corporation of India Limited, is an Indian company that provides power trading solutions, cross border power trading, and consultancy services. Headquartered in New Delhi, the company also has operations in Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh. PTC India's subsidiaries PTC India Financial Services Limited and PTC Energy Limited provide financial assistance for companies in the power sector and run renewable energy projects respectively. 16% of the company is publicly owned by the Indian government.

As of January 2019, PTC Energy managed a renewable energy portfolio of around 290 megawatts of wind assets across Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.
In 2020, PTC received approval to create India's third power exchange after Indian Energy Exchange (IEX) and Power Exchange India (PXIL).
